gate_results.gate_id: D2-006-G5: Cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL

observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6b. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0005, the H-005 trial_log entry, and TEST-08 reproducibility audit. H-005 produced positive full-period Sharpe of 0.3751092454780985, below the 1.0 promotion threshold, while max drawdown reached 212.0803% and cost drag reached 445.53% of gross PnL. The strategy failed 5 of 8 D2-006 gates, both long and short legs were negative on net PnL, and DEC-0005 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit and fix conclusions, the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: The tested 1h MACD crossover plus price-structure confirmation baseline is not promotable under current cost, drawdown, Sharpe, and concentration gates.
Intraday single-indicator momentum with OHLCV-only structure confirmation produced high turnover and inadequate edge under the modeled cost framework.
Cost drag at 1h frequency was fatal to the marginal pre-cost edge: DEC-0005 recorded gross PnL of 13184.28 against total modeled costs of 58740.3283.
Higher trade frequency did not improve signal quality; H-005 recorded 934 trades and still failed 5 of 8 gates.
Future intraday momentum work needs a materially different rationale for turnover control, regime selection, independent confirmation streams, or exit design before registration.
